title: fix: regex tweaks, generalize directives
body: This fixes an issue with the keybind directive needing to have specific regex include whitespace for the `=` token, by making the `key` regex ignore whitespace. It also generalizes the directives into a function and replaces `0-9` with `\d` for numbers in regex. This should fix issues with the syntax highlighting for the `=` sign with the `keybind` directive as well.
author: gerblesh

comments.body: Squashed everything. Should be ready for merging unless there's something that needs changing/fixing
